사과아저씨- 한국의 모든것들!/All Around Korea!
snippet.description:
서울과 제주도에 살고 있는 브라이언 친구들이 좋아하는 것들에 대해서 말해준대요! / Brian friends in Seoul and Jeju-do write in to tell us their favourite things to do!

오늘 신청하세요! http://goo.gl/T2qZ8E

snippet.title: 사과아저씨- 날씨가 춥네요! /It's Cold!
snippet.description:
브라이언이 추운날씨에 따뜻한 옷을 입지않았네요. 하지만 친구 매트가 브라이언이 따뜻할 수 있도록 도와준대요! / Brian doesn't dress for the cold weather, luckily his friend Matt is there to help!

오늘 신청하세요! http://goo.gl/T2qZ8E

snippet.title: 사과아저씨- 산타 할아버지가 온대요!/ A visit from Santa!
snippet.description:
빨간 옷을 입은 산타할아버지가 브라이언에게 온대요! 어떤 선물을 가져왔을까요?/ The big man in red comes by to visit Brian! What presents do you think he brought with him?

오늘 신청하세요! http://goo.gl/T2qZ8E

snippet.title: 사과아저씨-산타에게 보내는 편지 / A Letter To Santa
snippet.description:
산타클로스가 곧 온대요! 브라이언이 갖고 싶은 것을 적어본대요. 브라이언이 크리스마스에 산타할아버지에게 원하는것을 받을수 있도록 함께 도와줘볼까요?/ Santa's Coming! Help Brian make his Christmas list so he can send it in time for Christmas!

snippet.description:
hen Felix the Frog spends a night at the Cozy Hole with the Spider family, he decides he’d rather be a bug and never go home to his frog parents.  In order to bring the froggy family together, Miss Spider goes to the Taddy Puddle for a parent to parent chat.   But Spiderus misinterprets the situation and sets off a frog versus bug battle.

snippet.title: 미스 스파이더 (Miss Spider): 초록괴물 소동  - Ep.25
snippet.description:
The Spider kids disguise their frog friend Felix as a big green bug in an effort to have him join them at the ‘Be Good to Bugs Day’ fair. While Felix is unable to attend, he becomes an honorary bug when he saves his friends from a raging storm and spends the night in the Cozy Hole.

snippet.title: 미스 스파이더 (Miss Spider): 꼬마 개구리 펠릭스  - Ep.24
snippet.description:
Squirt, Shimmer and Spinner are playing in the Taddy Puddle when they come across Felix the frog – a sweet natured amphibian who’s tongue challenged.  When the little bugs take pity on him and untangle his tongue from a cattail, they discover Felix, unlike other frogs, isn’t a bug eater.  The bugs and frog become instant playmates.

snippet.description:

When the little bugs take pity on him and untangle his tongue from a cattail, they discover Felix, unlike other frogs, isn’t a bug eater.  The bugs and frog become instant playmates.
